title: Research library manifest
description: research-library.json at the root of a private research library: where each part of a captured entry goes, which provenance format it uses, and the commands that check it. Paths are relative to the library root and use {slug} (the entry) and {name} (a helper). research-library.mjs enforces this without a schema library.

private.description: The library is a private repo. Capture checks GitHub too, and refuses a public one.

store.description: The folder for the entry's desk store: hypotheses, coverage, sources, claims, the fact-check disposition.

data.description: The folder for measurement runs and raw data. May equal store.

helper.description: One brief per helper; {name} is the helper's short name.

index.description: Files that list every entry, and how one entry is added to each.

insert.description: after-anchor: a new block after the anchor line (newest first). line-end: text added to the end of the anchor line. table-end: a row after the last row of the table that starts at the anchor line. file-end: at the end of the file.

anchor.description: The start of the line to find. Needed unless insert is file-end.

entry.description: The text to add. May use {slug}, {date}, {title}, {summary}, {question}, {decision}, {status}, {recheck}, {model}, {effort}, {project}.

id.description: The record format's name, e.g. research-provenance/1. Two libraries can use one name for different shapes, so the schema file decides.

schema.description: The JSON Schema file in the library that the record must match.

paths.description: What a brief path inside the record is relative to: the entry's store folder, or the library root.

checks.description: Commands run from the library root. All must pass before the pull request opens.
